verdict.rationale: A direct probe got HTTP 200 at https://docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json, and the response contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec can be downloaded. A community comment also refers to CodeRabbit's API, which corroborates that a programmatic API exists. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the API and spec (endpoints covered, versioning, authentication), evidence of how much of the product the spec covers, and hands-on reports of using the spec in agent tooling.
